title: Education & Syllabus
intro: Students receive complete training for priesthood and academic education up to S.S.C. at the D.P.Y.A. High School, along with religious knowledge, Iranian history and Bhantar meaning.

curriculum.texts: Khordeh Avesta in Gujarati script: Kasti prayers, Din-no-Kalmo, Jamvani Baj, 101 names of God, 30 roz, 12 mah, Hamkaras, Geh, Gahambars, Gathas, Sarosh Baj, Tandarosti, Hoshbam, 5 Geh, Patet Pashemani, 5 Nyaishnas, and more.
Avestan script introduced; Yasna learning begins (up to Ha 10).
Entire Yasna (to Ha 72); Visparad, supplementary texts, Afringans, various Baj
Daily priestly rituals: Afringans, Afrins, Farokhshi, Jashan; Vendidad Fragard I–XII
Vendidad Fragard XIII–XXII and allied prayers; readiness for Maratab
